content_units: Sales Performance Snapshot
Here’s the clearest read of the dataset across   3 months   and   2 regions  .
-   Total revenue:     $228,500
-   Total units sold:     4,760
-   Total returns:     167
-   Overall return rate:     3.5%   of units
Best Charts for This Dataset
Chart   Best Use   Why it works
Line chart   Revenue trend by month for North vs South   Best for showing month-to-month movement and regional trend direction
Clustered column chart   Units sold by month and region   Makes side-by-side volume comparison easy
Combo chart   Revenue as columns + returns rate as line   Shows whether stronger sales are coming with healthier or weaker quality/fulfillment outcomes
Stacked bar chart   Total quarterly revenue by region   Quickly shows contribution share of North vs South
Recommended Chart Setup
Option 1:   Revenue Trend by Region     Compare monthly performance momentum between North and South   Best single chart for trend clarity
Option 2:   Units Sold Comparison     Show monthly sales volume side by side by region   Best for operational volume tracking
Option 3:   Revenue vs Return Rate Combo     Link commercial performance with product/service quality   Best for management review
Option 4:   Regional Revenue Share     Summarize which region contributes more across the quarter   Best for executive snapshot
Performance Insights from the Data
-   North is the stronger region overall.   It generated   $132,000   in revenue versus   $96,500   for South, contributing about   58%   of total revenue.
-   South is more volatile month to month.   Revenue fell from   $31,500   in January to   $29,800   in February, then rebounded sharply to   $35,200   in March.
-   North is more efficient on returns.   North had   74 returns on 2,610 units   (   2.8%  ), while South had   93 returns on 2,150 units   (   4.3%  ).
-   March shows mixed signals.   South posted its best revenue month in March, but North’s returns also rose to   28  , suggesting a possible service or product-quality issue despite solid sales.
